meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 没有专门视频流程适配时,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 组合来创建或编辑多场景视频,如宣传片、混剪和静态片头;它会沿用手头的素材与设计资源,推动计划、分镜到渲染审批等环节。
howto.when: 没有更专门的视频技能适用,或项目 BRIEF.md 将 flow 设为 companion(协作)时触发;适用品牌宣传片、混剪、静态循环等多场景内容。

say.text: 请按 HyperFrames 流程规划一支多场景的宣传片。
say.note: Claude 会先给出一版计划与分镜。

say.text: 把这个项目现有的前两幕改快,并加一条静帧片尾。
say.note: 按特定修改执行,不重开创意流程。

say.text: 这个项目改用伴生模式,先给我整套可取舍的方案。
say.note: 会先提出导演级完整方案,而不是零散指令。

howto.what_en: Without a specialized workflow, Claude creates/edits HyperFrames compositions for longer or multi-scene videos (brand reels, montages, static loops). It routes media/Figma inputs through plan, build, and render gates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Typical use: brand reels, montages, static loops; short motion-first pieces use motion-graphics.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-scene brand film as a HyperFrames composition.
say_en.note: Claude will draft storyboards and pacing first.

say_en.text: Edit this project: tighten the first two acts and add a static end card.
say_en.note: Runs as a specific edit, keeping project decisions.

say_en.text: This brief is set to companion mode—let's co-create the film.
say_en.note: Claude will offer an ambitious, full plan to trim.
